stem: What can the reader tell about the narrator's feelings for Cowboy?

options.label: F
options.text: She hoped her father would trade him for another horse.

options.label: G
options.text: She wished he looked more like her brown pony.

options.label: H
options.text: She was concerned about his inability to win a competition.

options.label: J
options.text: She was fond of him regardless of his appearance.
